users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Accounts that can access the console and their role.
users.mustChange: Require a password change at first sign-in
users.resetExplain: The new password replaces the current one, unlocks the account and closes all the user's open sessions.
deleteConsequences: The user can no longer sign in and their sessions are closed.
Audit log entries remain (with the username).

roleHelp.admin: Administrator: can do everything, including user management, settings, backups and destructive operations.
roleHelp.operator: Operator: monitoring, deploy, restart, scale, rollout, logs and troubleshooting; does not manage users or settings.
roleHelp.viewer: Viewer: read-only access to cluster and containers; cannot see logs or Secret values.

errors.passwordShort: The password must have at least 12 characters.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.exists: A user with this name already exists.
errors.self: You cannot delete your own account or remove your own administrator rights.
errors.last_admin: At least one active administrator must remain.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: The three built-in roles and what they allow.
roles.enforced: Permissions are checked by the backend on every request: hiding a button in the interface is not the only protection. Every denied attempt is recorded in the audit log.

describe.operator: Operator: manages applications day to day without changing the console configuration.
describe.viewer: Observer: looks at the status without being able to change anything.

can_admin: Delete resources, apply YAML of any kind, manage Secrets
can_operator: Publish applications (deploy), scale, restart, rollout and rollback
Start, stop and restart Podman containers
can_viewer: View cluster, resources, events and metrics

perms.title: Permissions
perms.subtitle: Permission matrix per role. Every backend API requires one of these permissions.

describe.cluster.read: View Kubernetes resources, events, relations and diagnostics
describe.secrets.read_values: View Secret values in clear text and create/change them (audited)
describe.logs.read: Read and download Pod and container logs
describe.workloads.deploy: Publish applications and apply YAML of application resources
describe.workloads.restart: Restart Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets and Pods
describe.workloads.rollout: Pause, resume and roll back rollouts; suspend CronJobs
describe.resources.apply: Apply YAML of any supported kind (e.g. Namespace, Secret) and force conflicts
describe.resources.delete: Delete resources other than Pods (Deployments, Namespaces, PVCs…)
describe.nodes.maintain: Put nodes in maintenance (cordon, uncordon, drain)
describe.podman.read: View Podman containers, images and registries
describe.podman.operate: Start, stop and restart Podman containers
describe.podman.manage: Remove containers, pull and remove Podman images
describe.monitoring.read: View metrics, health and system status
describe.audit.read: View and export the audit log
describe.backup.manage: Run, verify, download and delete backups

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Record of significant operations: who did what, when, on which resource and with what result. Retention: {{days}} days.
